domains.description: Answering questions from the ingested awesome-courses curriculum (212 university courses across 11 subjects). Extractive and read-only: the agent quotes or summarizes the field guides and course texts, never invents course content.
example_prompts: What does the Systems field guide recommend as a starting point?
Which courses cover distributed consensus?
Summarize the Algorithms curriculum
known_limits: Extractive only — the agent has not 'studied' the courses; it reads the guides.
Dead links and video lectures were never ingested; coverage.json shows exactly what is in.
No credential or certification implied.
domains.name: Curriculum Q&A

domains.description: Recalling dated news headlines previously ingested by refresh.py. Every answer MUST cite the item dates — this is recall of a snapshot, not live awareness.
example_prompts: What were the top Hacker News stories on 2026-09-15?
Any recent arXiv cs.AI papers in the digest?
Search the news archive for semiconductor news
known_limits: Only as fresh as the last refresh.py run; dates must always be shown.
Headlines and summaries only — no full article text.
No live browsing; if nothing was ingested, the agent says so.
domains.name: Current events (dated recall)

domains.description: Arithmetic, unit conversion, percentages, and quantitative reasoning worked out step by step through shell calculation or careful reasoning. No symbolic algebra engine.
example_prompts: What is 15% of 23,400?
Convert 2.5 GB to MiB
If a job runs 3x weekly, how many runs per quarter?
known_limits: No CAS (no sympy/wolfram); multi-step symbolic math is done by careful reasoning and may err.
The agent should show its work so errors are checkable.
domains.name: Math & quantitative reasoning

domains.description: Writing, explaining, and debugging code inside the workspace sandbox. The agent can create files, run them, read errors, and iterate — with confirmation gates on writes and shell execution.
example_prompts: Write a Python script that parses this CSV
Why does this test fail?
Explain what this module does
known_limits: Gated: file_write/file_edit/shell_exec need consent (--yes or interactive).
Sandboxed to the workspace root; no network installs unless the human approves.
Destructive shell patterns are blocked even with consent.
domains.name: Code writing, debugging, explanation

domains.description: Drafting and editing prose: notes, docs, summaries, plans. File tools are gated; the agent drafts in chat freely.
example_prompts: Draft a project plan
Rewrite this paragraph more concisely
Summarize these meeting notes
known_limits: Long-form factual writing should be grounded in ingested sources or fetched pages, not improvised.
File writes need consent.
domains.name: Writing & editing

domains.description: Condensing long texts (ingested course pages, files, fetched articles) into shorter briefs. Extractive-first: quote, then compress.
example_prompts: Summarize the Systems field guide
Give me the key points of this article
known_limits: Summaries of web content require fetching it first (web_fetch, gated).
The agent must not present a summary as a quote.
domains.name: Summarization

domains.description: Breaking a goal into ordered steps, then executing them with tool calls and confirmation gates where needed.
example_prompts: Plan a weekend trip
Break down this migration into steps
Research then summarize a topic
known_limits: Plans are proposals until the human approves consequential steps.
The agent cannot commit the human's time/money — only its own tool calls.
domains.name: Planning & task breakdown

domains.description: Running subtasks in an isolated worker thread (delegate) and listing/loading the skill catalog (842 skills). Delegated subtasks inherit consent; gates stay gated inside.
example_prompts: Research this in the background while I do X
What skills do you have for security?
Load the playbook for incident response
known_limits: A failing subtask is reported as failed (honest propagation) — delegation is not a success guarantee.
Skills are playbooks/knowledge, not superpowers.
domains.name: Tool use & delegation

domains.description: The agent's own scratch memory (memory_write/memory_read) plus chat session persistence. Short-term within a session; durable facts only if written to memory.
example_prompts: Remember that I prefer concise answers
What did we decide about the deploy?
known_limits: Scratch memory is per-agent working memory, not the user's long-term profile.
Session history compresses at 80% context — old turns become summaries, never silently dropped.
domains.name: Memory & continuity

domains.description: Reading, writing, editing files and running shell commands inside the workspace sandbox, all confirmation-gated except reads.
example_prompts: List the files in this project
Run the test suite
Create a notes file
known_limits: Writes and shell execution require consent; destructive patterns are hard-blocked.
No access outside the workspace root.
domains.name: File & shell operation

domains.description: Searching the web and fetching pages for research. Search is ungated; fetching a page needs consent. Results are cited with URLs.
example_prompts: Research current best practices for Postgres backups
Find the docs for this library
known_limits: web_fetch is gated (consent).
The agent cannot log in anywhere or bypass paywalls.
Findings should be cited; the agent must not present search snippets as verified facts.
domains.name: Web research

domains.description: Small-scale data crunching with shell tools (awk/python) over workspace files. Descriptive stats and text processing, not a BI platform.
example_prompts: How many courses per subject are in the catalog?
Count error lines in this log
known_limits: CPU-only, workspace-local data.
No pandas/numpy in core (stdlib-only); shell python is available with consent.
domains.name: Data analysis

domains.description: Stories, poems, brainstorms, and playful registers (KAI-9000 literary/grok/muse). Original output in LEVI's own voice.
example_prompts: Write a flash story about a lighthouse
Brainstorm names for my project
Roast my draft (gently)
known_limits: Creative work is original prose, not expertise.
The companion/care registers are personas, not therapists.
domains.name: Creative work

domains.description: Adding and listing cron-scheduled automations backed by the AutomationRegistry. Adding is gated.
example_prompts: Remind me every morning at 8
What automations are scheduled?
known_limits: schedule_add needs consent.
The agent cannot guarantee delivery — schedules run in LEVI's runtime, not the user's phone.
domains.name: Scheduling & automation
